_comment: Sample deploy-guard config. Copy to config.json and edit for your fork. The real config.json is gitignored (per-fork, contains your project list). All paths/projects below are placeholders.

review_models._comment: Optional. Override plan-review model/effort per reviewer id (sol|muse|argon|codex). Omit to keep built-in defaults (argon = gemini-4-argon-medium/medium). Existing review receipts must match; changing this invalidates receipts of open plans.
